body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and learn whether it currently has any damage-reduction benefit; learn its value, not concealed abilities.

surges.html: On a hit, suppress 1 point of its next ordinary damage reduction until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Ambush
rider.html: When the target receives an ordinary defensive benefit before your next turn, it becomes Exposed after that benefit resolves.
